cohort: 105 preterm infants with gestational ages ranging from 27.0 to 36.7 weeks admitted within 24 h following birth.
finding: A predictive model for PDA in preterm infants at seven days postpartum, based on birth weight, mechanical ventilation, LVEDd, LD, and logIT, demonstrated excellent discriminative power (AUC 0.985) and clinical utility.
